data.name: PendingActivity
data.value: This screen is not built yet.

data.name: LinkHintIdle
data.value: Pick a saved link on the Links page and press Connect.

data.name: LinkHintIdleSimulator
data.value: Pick a saved link on the Links page and press Connect; a SITL link starts its simulator first.

data.name: LinkHintConnecting
data.value: The steps below show how far it has got. Cancel stops waiting.

data.name: LinkHintConnected
data.value: Telemetry, commands, parameters and missions go over this link.

data.name: LinkHintLost
data.value: No heartbeat for a while. The link stays open and picks the vehicle up again when it returns.

data.name: LinkSimulatorAddress
data.value: simulator link: its address is found when the simulator runs

data.name: LinkConfirmSwitch
data.value: The vehicle is armed. Switching to {0} closes the current link first.

data.name: LinkConfirmDisconnect
data.value: The vehicle is armed. Disconnecting stops this station's telemetry and commands.

data.name: LinkLogEmpty
data.value: Link events and simulator output appear here.

data.name: TipHeartbeat
data.value: Time since the vehicle's last HEARTBEAT. The autopilot sends one every second; yellow after 1.5 s, red after 3 s.

data.name: TipIdentity
data.value: MAVLink ids: the vehicle's system id and its autopilot's component id. PX4 is usually 1 / 1.

data.name: TipAutopilot
data.value: Autopilot firmware family, as the heartbeat reports it.

data.name: TipVehicleType
data.value: Airframe class, as the heartbeat reports it.

data.name: TipLoss
data.value: Share of the vehicle's packets that never arrived, from gaps in their sequence numbers since the link opened. Yellow over 5 %, red over 20 %.

data.name: TipChecksum
data.value: Frames dropped because their checksum did not match: noise on a radio link, or a wrong baud rate on a serial one.

data.name: TipRssi
data.value: Signal strength at this station's radio / at the vehicle's radio, from RADIO_STATUS, in the radio's own units (about 2 × dB on SiK radios). Higher is better.

data.name: TipNoise
data.value: Background noise at each radio, in the same units. The further RSSI is above the noise, the more margin the link has.

data.name: TipTxBuffer
data.value: Free space in the radio's send buffer. Low means more is sent than the radio can carry; yellow under 30 %.

data.name: TipRxErrors
data.value: Packets the radio received damaged / damaged packets its error correction repaired.

data.name: LinkNoneSavedSimulator
data.value: No saved links yet. A SITL link starts its simulator and connects to it in one step.

data.name: FieldHostUdpTip
data.value: Empty: listen on the port and answer whoever sends (PX4 sends its GCS link to port 14550). With a host: send to it first.

data.name: LinkHintUdp
data.value: Leave the host empty to listen for the vehicle on the port, or give a host to send to it first.

data.name: LinkHintTcp
data.value: Connects to a MAVLink TCP server, such as a Wi-Fi telemetry bridge.

data.name: LinkHintSerial
data.value: A telemetry radio or a USB cable on this computer. Rescan if the port is missing.

data.name: LinkHintSimulator
data.value: Starts the simulator when it is not running, then connects to it. How it runs is set on the SITL page.

data.name: LinkErrorSerialPort
data.value: Pick a serial port; rescan after plugging it in.

data.name: SimulatorErrorHome
data.value: Enter the home as latitude −90…90 and longitude −180…180, in degrees.

data.name: SimulatorBlocked
data.value: Start needs the items marked missing.

data.name: SimulatorOpenWindowTip
data.value: Opens the simulator's 3D window. Closing it leaves the simulation running.

data.name: SimulatorCheckAgainTip
data.value: Looks at what this computer has again, e.g. after starting Docker.

data.name: SimulatorHelpWorld
data.value: The world the simulator starts in. The flat world starts wherever you put the home; a terrain world brings real ground around a fixed place, built from the terrain data the first time.

data.name: SimulatorHelpHome
data.value: Where the vehicle starts: latitude and longitude in degrees. Its altitude comes from the terrain data. A terrain world fixes the home.

data.name: SimulatorHelpEnvironment
data.value: What this computer needs to run the simulator. A missing item says how to fix it; the environment itself is built here, once per PX4 version.

data.name: CommandModeWaiting
data.value: accepted, waiting for the vehicle to report {0}

data.name: CommandModeNotConfirmed
data.value: mode not confirmed, the vehicle reports {0}

data.name: WeatherKeyWind
data.value: Wind, and where it comes from

data.name: PlanningMapPending
data.value: The map and plan editing are not built yet.

data.name: TelemetryAglHelp
data.value: Height above the terrain below the vehicle

data.name: TelemetryWaypointHelp
data.value: Distance to the active mission item

data.name: TelemetryWaypointEtaHelp
data.value: Time to the active mission item at the ground speed

data.name: TelemetryEndHelp
data.value: Time to the end of the mission with the way home, or to the home outside a mission

data.name: TelemetryHomeHelp
data.value: Distance and bearing to the home

data.name: TelemetryAltitudeErrorHelp
data.value: Target altitude minus altitude: + while below the target

data.name: TelemetryCrossTrackHelp
data.value: Distance off the planned line to the active item

data.name: TelemetryMarginHelp
data.value: Battery left at the end of the flight above the low-battery threshold (BAT_LOW_THR)

data.name: TelemetryMarginDetail
data.value: Battery left at the end above the low-battery threshold: needs {0:F0} mAh of {1:F0} mAh, at {2:F1} A ({3})

data.name: TelemetryVoltagePerCell
data.value: Battery voltage: {0:F2} V per cell over {1} cells

data.name: TelemetryTimeLeftHelp
data.value: Time the battery lasts: the autopilot's estimate, else at the present draw down to the low-battery threshold

data.name: PlanningEstimateHelp
data.value: Flight time and distance at the cruise speed and speed changes, in the wind the vehicle reports, with the way home when the mission ends with RTL. The margin is the battery left at the end above the low-battery threshold, from the battery now and the cruise current entered on the Power page.

data.name: PlanningEstimateNoEnergy
data.value: Enter the cruise current (and the capacity when the vehicle has none) on the Power page for an energy estimate.

data.name: SummaryReadyArmingUnknown
data.value: no health report (events metadata not loaded)

data.name: SummaryReadyEnergyDetail
data.value: {0:F0} % left at the end above the low-battery threshold ({1:F0} of {2:F0} mAh needed)

data.name: SummaryReadyEnergyUnknown
data.value: enter the cruise current on the Power page

data.name: PowerCruiseCurrentHelp
data.value: The current the aircraft draws in cruise. With the capacity it gives the mission energy estimate before flight; in flight the measured average replaces it after a minute.

data.name: PowerCapacityHelp
data.value: The battery capacity, used only while the vehicle's BAT1_CAPACITY is not set.

data.name: SceneFit
data.value: Fit the route and the aircraft, seen from above

data.name: PlanningAltitudeReferenceHelp
data.value: What item altitudes are measured from. Rel. home: above the planned home. AMSL: above mean sea level. AGL: above the ground under each item, sent as above sea level from the terrain data. Changing it converts every item so the plan flies the same heights.

data.name: PlanningReferenceRefused
data.value: The altitude reference was not changed

data.name: PlanningReferenceNoTerrain
data.value: Item {0} has no terrain data under it.

data.name: PlanningRangefinderUseHelp
data.value: How the landing uses the rangefinder's height above ground (FW_LND_USETER). Written to the vehicle with a mission that lands.

data.name: PlanningAbortNotFoundHelp
data.value: Abandon the landing and loiter when the rangefinder never finds the ground (FW_LND_ABORT bit 0). Off: the land point's altitude is the ground.

data.name: PlanningAbortLostHelp
data.value: Abandon the landing and loiter when the rangefinder loses the ground for more than a second (FW_LND_ABORT bit 1). Off: the last good height is used.

data.name: PlanningEndActionHelp
data.value: What the vehicle does after the last item. RTL: return to launch and land there. Hold: loiter at the last item.

data.name: PlanningNoItems
data.value: No mission items yet. Pick a type below, then click the map.

data.name: PlanningAddHint
data.value: Pick a type, then click the map

data.name: PlanningNoFences
data.value: No fences yet. Draw a polygon or drop a circle on the map.

data.name: PlanningDrawPolygon
data.value: Polygon fence: click the corners, right-click to finish

data.name: PlanningToggleKind
data.value: Switch between stay in and keep out

data.name: PlanningPolygonNeedsCorners
data.value: A polygon fence needs at least three corners.

data.value: The firmware describes nothing about this parameter.

data.name: ParamsConfirmReboot
data.value: Reboot the autopilot? The link drops while it starts again.

data.name: ParamsConfirmReset
data.value: Reset every parameter to its firmware default? Calibrations and setup are lost; reboot afterwards.

data.name: ParamsReviewOtherVehicle
data.value: It was saved from another vehicle.

data.name: ParamsStaged

data.name: ParamsModifiedTip
data.value: Only parameters that differ from the firmware default

data.name: SetupLinkLost

data.name: SetupLogEmpty
data.value: Parameter writes, setup actions and the vehicle's messages appear here.

data.name: SetupNoVehicle
data.value: No vehicle connected: values appear once a vehicle is connected.

data.name: SummaryNotFixedWing
data.value: This vehicle is not configured as a fixed-wing (CA_AIRFRAME).

data.name: ParamCheck_stall_above_min
data.value: Invalid: the stall airspeed is above the minimum airspeed.

data.name: ParamCheck_max_below_min
data.value: Invalid: the maximum airspeed is below the minimum airspeed.

data.name: ParamCheck_trim_outside
data.value: Invalid: the trim airspeed is outside the minimum to maximum range.

data.name: ParamCheck_bank_infeasible
data.value: Invalid: the maximum airspeed is too low to hold the maximum bank angle (FW_R_LIM) at gross weight. Raise FW_AIRSPD_MAX or lower FW_R_LIM.

data.name: SensorsCompassHelp
data.value: Rotate the vehicle through every orientation shown until each is marked complete. Stay away from metal, magnets and running motors.

data.name: SensorsGyroHelp
data.value: Place the vehicle on a steady surface and do not move it.

data.name: SensorsAccelerometerHelp
data.value: Hold the vehicle still in each orientation shown when asked. The vehicle detects each orientation by itself.

data.name: SensorsLevelHelp
data.value: Place the vehicle in its level cruise attitude and keep it still.

data.name: SensorsAirspeedHelp
data.value: Shield the pitot tube from wind. When asked, blow gently into the pitot tube until the vehicle confirms.

data.name: SensorsOrientationNote
data.value: "No rotation" means the component points in the direction of flight. Only external compasses can be rotated.

data.name: SensorsStarting
data.value: Waiting for the vehicle to start the calibration...

data.name: SensorsCancelling
data.value: Waiting for the vehicle to cancel...

data.name: SensorsCancelled
data.value: Calibration cancelled. The previous calibration is kept.

data.name: RadioNotUsed
data.value: Manual control source is "{0}", so RC calibration is not required. It can still be done when a receiver is connected.

data.name: RadioCancelled
data.value: RC calibration cancelled; nothing was written.

data.name: RadioCopyTrimsTip
data.value: Store the current stick positions as the trims

data.name: RadioStepNeutral
data.value: Lower the throttle stick all the way and centre the other sticks. Disconnect motor power or remove the propeller. Then press Next.

data.name: RadioStepThrottleUp
data.value: Move the throttle stick all the way up and hold it there...

data.name: RadioStepThrottleDown
data.value: Move the throttle stick all the way down and leave it there...

data.name: RadioStepYawRight
data.value: Move the yaw (rudder) stick all the way right and hold it there...

data.name: RadioStepYawLeft
data.value: Move the yaw (rudder) stick all the way left and hold it there...

data.name: RadioStepRollRight
data.value: Move the roll (aileron) stick all the way right and hold it there...

data.name: RadioStepRollLeft
data.value: Move the roll (aileron) stick all the way left and hold it there...

data.name: RadioStepPitchUp
data.value: Move the pitch (elevator) stick all the way up and hold it there...

data.name: RadioStepPitchDown
data.value: Move the pitch (elevator) stick all the way down and hold it there...

data.name: RadioStepSwitches
data.value: Move every switch and dial to both of its ends, then press Next.

data.name: RadioStepComplete
data.value: Everything is captured. Next writes it to the vehicle.

data.name: RadioIntro
data.value: Maps the sticks and records each channel's range. The result is written at the end; nothing is written if it is cancelled.

data.name: PowerNoReading
data.value: no battery reading from the vehicle
